text: The account holder is Sadia Qadir with account PK**HABB****8054 opened on 14 January 2026. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. Between 4 July 2026 and 6 August 2026 the account received 17 credits totalling PKR 28,214,000 and made 7 debits totalling PKR 21,905,000. There were 16 cash deposits totalling PKR 28,064,000 made at 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 6 August 2026, with a typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Repeated cash deposits just below the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, with 14 of 16 deposits between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 26,086,000, are indicative of structuring. Deposits were spread across 4 branches, suggesting an attempt to avoid detection by dispersing cash activity. There was more than one cash deposit on 12 July 2026, which is consistent with structuring behaviour. The cash volume, 188.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000, is inconsistent with the subject's declared income. These patterns are consistent with suspected structuring activity. PKR 9,069,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in 3 transactions. PKR 6,970,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 5,866,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank A) in 2 transactions. Debits equal to 78% of credits were paid out with a median of 25.0 hours between the latest credit and each debit. No match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening was found on 30 July 2026. Account placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision; no contact was made with the customer about this review.
